name: checksum16_even_length
description: IPv4 header checksum over an even-length byte string (RFC 1071-style worked example).

name: checksum16_odd_length_padding
description: checksum16 with an odd-length input, exercising the trailing zero-byte pad before summing.

name: checksum16_real_ipv4_header
description: checksum16 over a realistic 20-byte IPv4 header (checksum field zeroed), matching what build_udp computes internally.

name: build_udp_basic
description: build_udp with a small non-empty payload; covers Ethernet+IPv4+UDP header assembly and the IPv4 checksum.

name: build_udp_empty_payload
description: build_udp with a zero-length payload -- edge case for the length/checksum fields.

name: build_arp_request_basic
description: build_arp_request: a broadcast 'who-has GOGGLES_IP' ARP request, as sent by resolve_goggles_mac.

name: build_arp_reply_basic
description: build_arp_reply: a unicast ARP reply to the goggles, as sent by main()'s ARP-request handler.

name: parse_udp_round_trip
description: parse_udp fed the exact output of build_udp_basic -- round-trip success case.

name: parse_udp_too_short_returns_none
description: parse_udp on a frame shorter than the minimum Ethernet+IPv4+UDP length -- must return None.

name: parse_udp_wrong_ethertype_returns_none
description: parse_udp on a long-enough frame whose EtherType is ARP (0x0806), not IPv4 (0x0800) -- must return None.

name: parse_arp_round_trip_request
description: parse_arp fed the exact output of build_arp_request_basic -- round-trip success case (op=1, who-has).

name: parse_arp_round_trip_reply
description: parse_arp fed the exact output of build_arp_reply_basic -- round-trip success case (op=2, is-at).

name: parse_arp_too_short_returns_none
description: parse_arp on a frame shorter than the minimum ARP-over-Ethernet length -- must return None.

name: wrap_packet_msg_single
description: wrap_packet_msg over one small Ethernet frame -- basic RNDIS_PACKET_MSG framing.

name: unwrap_packet_msg_single
description: unwrap_packet_msg fed the exact output of wrap_packet_msg_single -- single-message round trip.

name: unwrap_packet_msg_multi_message_buffer
description: unwrap_packet_msg over a buffer containing three back-to-back RNDIS_PACKET_MSG structures (as a single bulk-IN read can deliver) -- multi-message round trip required by design.md §9.1 item 2.

name: build_outer_pkt_type_handshake
description: build_outer with pkt_type=0x00 (handshake), a fixed SESSION_ID (0x1234), and a small body -- exercises the XOR checksum byte and the 0x8000 length-field bit for this packet type.

name: build_outer_pkt_type_telemetry
description: build_outer with pkt_type=0x01 (telemetry), a fixed SESSION_ID (0x1234), and a small body -- exercises the XOR checksum byte and the 0x8000 length-field bit for this packet type.

name: build_outer_pkt_type_video
description: build_outer with pkt_type=0x02 (video), a fixed SESSION_ID (0x1234), and a small body -- exercises the XOR checksum byte and the 0x8000 length-field bit for this packet type.

name: build_outer_pkt_type_ack
description: build_outer with pkt_type=0x04 (ack), a fixed SESSION_ID (0x1234), and a small body -- exercises the XOR checksum byte and the 0x8000 length-field bit for this packet type.

name: handshake_48_bytes
description: The full 48-byte handshake frame: build_outer(0x00, seq=0, HANDSHAKE_BODY) with the fixed SESSION_ID -- HANDSHAKE_BODY is the prototype's 40-byte empirically-derived constant.

name: ack_22_byte_body
description: The full ack frame from build_ack: an 8-byte build_outer(0x04, ...) header wrapping the 22-byte ack body (4-byte start/end seq range + the 18-byte ACK_TEMPLATE_TAIL constant) -- 30 bytes total.

name: duml_crc8_header
description: duml.crc8 over a 3-byte DUML header prefix (magic + length/version bytes), the standard header-CRC use, default seed 0x77.

name: duml_crc16_whole_frame_prefix
description: duml.crc16 over an 11-byte DUML header (everything but the trailing CRC-16 itself), default seed 0x3692.

name: duml_build_02_b3_iframe_request
description: duml.build reproducing send_request_iframe's exact call -- the I-frame-request DUML frame (cmd_set=0x02, cmd_id=0xB3), empty payload.

name: duml_build_with_nonempty_payload
description: duml.build with a non-empty 6-byte payload -- edge case exercising the payload-length-dependent CRC-16 over the whole frame.

name: duml_parse_stream_synthetic_if4
description: SYNTHETIC (not a hardware capture): duml.parse_stream over a hand-built buffer of two valid duml.build() frames, one frame with a corrupted CRC-16 (must be rejected/skipped), and a truncated trailing partial frame (must be left as the unconsumed tail) -- exercises CRC-8 and CRC-16 both.

name: duml_parse_stream_synthetic_clean_two_frames
description: SYNTHETIC (not a hardware capture): duml.parse_stream over exactly two valid, back-to-back duml.build() frames with no corruption and no trailing partial data -- baseline multi-frame case, empty tail expected.
